name: 95832 · Sacramento, CA
findings: ZIP 95832 (Sacramento) has 25 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (52%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (38% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 95832 (Sacramento) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
